name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side, squatting deep on that leg while the other leg extends straight.
Keep the straight leg's heel on the floor and torso upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to center, then alternate sides.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate bodyweight squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Cossack Squat develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
